reviewNotes: All BODY units U000411-U000433 were read in source order from the admitted canonical derivative.
Original scan printed pp. 59-62 (scan pp. 63-66) was directly visually inspected.
Genotypische and genotropische Erscheinungsform are preserved as distinct source definitions.
All five main forms of Genotropismus are represented: Libido/Eroto-, Idealo-, Opero-, Morbo- and Thanatotropismus.
The Opero-Genotropismus examples retain `pyromanisch`, `kriminell`, `homosexuell`, `Irrenhaus` and `geisteskrank`, together with Szondi's explicit anti-overgeneralization in U000426.
Morbotropismus retains the claim that latent genes determine the form of illness appearing in response to external damage; no contemporary causal validation is introduced.
Thanatotropismus retains the familial-gene claim and the weaker `scheint` force of the suicide sentence, represented as SUSPICION_INDICATION.
No P2B vocational, diagnostic, disease-selection, death-selection or suicide inference rule is introduced.
